title: Psalms 81
paragraphs: ¹ Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob! ² Begin the music, strike the timbrel, play the sweet harp and psaltery. ³ Sound the ram's horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our festival. ⁴ For this is a decree for Israel, a law given by the God of Jacob. ⁵ He established it as a covenant with Joseph when he went out against Egypt, where we heard a language we did not understand.

⁶ He removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were freed from the basket. ⁷ "In your distress you called out and I rescued you; I answered you from the shelter of thunder and tested you at the waters of Meribah." Selah. ⁸ "Hear, my people, and I will warn you — O Israel, if only you would listen to me! ⁹ There shall be no foreign god among you; you shall not bow down to any alien god. ¹⁰ I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open your mouth wide and I will fill it."

¹¹ "But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me. ¹² So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts, to follow their own devices. ¹³ If only my people would listen to me, if Israel would only walk in my ways! ¹⁴ How quickly I would subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their oppressors! ¹⁵ Those who hate the LORD would cringe before him, and their doom would last forever."
¹⁶ "But you would be fed with the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."
